chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamza, from one of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about the found property (luqatah). He said: 'It should be announced for a year, whether it is little or much.' He said: 'And whatever is less than a dirham, it should not be announced.'

key_terms.الدِّرْهَم: A silver coin, used here as a threshold for value

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling for found property (luqatah) and how long must it be announced?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the jurisprudential standard for 'luqatah' (found property), mandating a one-year announcement period for items of significant value to ensure the owner's right is preserved. It introduces a practical threshold of one dirham, below which the administrative burden of announcement is waived, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on balancing legal obligation with economic reality. This ruling underscores the principle of protecting wealth while preventing unnecessary hardship for the finder.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muhammad Bin Abu Hamza, from one of our companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the found property, he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘You should introduce it (to others) for a year, be it a little or a lot’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So whatever was less than the Dirham, so do not introduce it (seek for its owner)’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Muhammad ibn abu Hamzah from certain persons of his people who has said the following: “This is concerning my question before abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about lost property found.

He (the Imam) said, ‘You must (continue to) announce your finding in public for one year, regardless of its quantity - whether small or a large quantity.’ He (the Imam) then said, ‘If it is less than a dirham one does not need to make any announcements.’”
